note: Catalogue of every movement the Tactical3DV2 engine can produce today, with its source, parameters, contacts and the gate that measures it. 'mocap' = skeletal clip retargeted from an E2A-owned take (src/t3d/clips, played by skelclip.ts); 'procedural' = generated by src/t3d/rig.ts from the play track + actions. No third-party motion data. status: 'verified' = rendered and measured (gate named), 'implemented' = in the engine, measured by the gates but not yet seen in a published render, 'proposed' = not implemented.
skeleton: e2a-player-v1, 21 bones (hips spine chest neck head clavicle/upperarm/forearm/hand L-R thigh/shin/foot/toe L-R), H 2.1 rig units scaled per player
root_motion: the PLAY track owns placement and clock (posAt); clips keep their own local displacement and are warped by milestones; procedural gait derives stride phase from distance

entries.limits: single camera, 30 fps, frontal: knee flexion and pelvis drop under-observed

entries.contacts: per foot: planted in stance, swing arc otherwise; reach guard lifts a foot the hips left behind

entries.realism_v2: a slow (< 0.2 m/s) player only lifts the foot that is OFF its base: a set screener / a defender in stance no longer marks time
entries.status: implemented (V2 flag), measured: O4 pin-down both feet planted at X2's closest approach

params.brake: baseAt() widens the base the next plant needs

entries.realism_v2: heading rate clamped to 12 rad/s (legacy peaked at 1678 deg/s when a facing target switched)

covers: pivot on the ball of the foot

params.face: player id, 'ball' or a FIXED angle (rad)

entries.realism_v2: Chicago V2 sets the pin-down at a fixed angle (chest to X2's start): tracking the moving defender turned the screener ~150 deg on the spot

covers: short roll after a pin-down / pick

entries.realism_v2: ball dribbled wider and ahead with speed: the stride's thigh no longer sweeps through it (13-15 cm -> <= 4.5 cm)

params.grip: right hand ON TOP (R + 1.2 cm), left hand BEHIND the ball

entries.realism_v2: palms on the ball surface via contact IK (4 passes), hand tangent to the ball; release: hands peel off over 0.2 s and come back to the body over 0.18 s
entries.status: implemented (V2 flag), measured: palms 0.130-0.135 m from the ball centre

params.v2_grip: palms stay ON the ball through the rise (contact IK keeps the grip)

entries.status: implemented (V2 flag), measured: palms off <= 3.9 cm (legacy 12 cm)

entries.source: src/t3d/cloth2.ts (damped spring driven by pelvis acceleration, jump height and heading angular acceleration)

entries.status: proposed: PENDIENTE DE EJECUCION (no cloth bake run; LOD-A not built)
proposed: needs E2A takes from a 90 deg profile at 60 fps
